learned_patterns.pattern: Second gap-through-stop on a high-ATR single name (INTC -14.98%, after MRVL -5.71%). Wide ATR stops do not cap tail risk on gaps; the durable fix is instrument selection (single-name semis -> SOXX/ETF, §13.3).

The INTC stop-out organically pulled LAB from 25.9% (over its 20% cap) to 18.0% (under). §17.3 forbids force-selling to rebalance; organic exits are the intended mechanism for normalizing an over-cap sleeve. LAB now has headroom for one fresh-matrix entry.
